feed.subtitle:
I am a prospective engineering student with strong foundations in mathematics, CAD software, technical drawings, and extensive experience of the engineering-design process. I was awarded Dux of the School having achieved the best grades in my year, AAAA at Advanced Higher, and have a number of personal projects demonstrating my technical ability.

I am seeking a work placement in the engineering sector prior to commencing university in September 2027.
